Let \(x=m-1>0\). Then \(m=x+1\), and from the corrected relation:
\[
n=\frac{2m}{m-1}=\frac{2(x+1)}{x}=2+\frac{2}{x}.
\]
So
\[
m+n=(x+1)+\left(2+\frac{2}{x}\right)=x+\frac{2}{x}+3.
\]
By AM-GM,
\[
x+\frac{2}{x}\ge 2\sqrt{2},
\]
so
\[
m+n\ge 3+2\sqrt{2}.
\]
Thus \(t=3+2\sqrt{2}\), and
\[
t-2\sqrt{2}=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
